.gstudio/artifacts/type/scripts/create/s.instruction: Run {{script}} <id> to scaffold the new type, where <id> is the type's identifier.

.gstudio/artifacts/type/scripts/list/ste.instruction: Run {{script}} [searchTerm] from the project root, where `searchTerm` is an optional string to filter types by content.

.gstudio/artifacts/type/scripts/update/s.instruction: Run {{script}} <id> to verify that the type identified by `<id>` exists before continuing the update action.

.gstudio/artifacts/type/scripts/delete/s.instruction: Run {{script}} <id> where <id> is the type's identifier (e.g. `{{script}} myType`).
Run {{script}} <id> to print every existing reference to the type's PascalCase name in the codebase, each on its own `[file path]:[line number]` line.

.gstudio/artifacts/type/scripts/evaluate.instruction: Run {{script}} <id> from the project root, passing the artifact's id as the sole argument.

create.text: Scaffolds a new type definition file at src/src/types/{Name}.type.ts from an id and optional content, failing if the file already exists.

list.text: Lists type artifacts in the codebase matching an optional search term, printing each result's id and file path.

update.text: Updates an existing type artifact's source file to satisfy a natural-language change request, given its id, erroring if the type doesn't exist.

delete.text: Deletes a type artifact by id, removing its file and cleaning up dangling references to it across the codebase.

evaluate.text: Checks that a type artifact's file location, single top-level shape, and domain-only scope comply with the rules, given the type's id, printing pass or itemized rule violations.
